faq_entry_schema.id: string — unique entry identifier (UUID or slug)
faq_entry_schema.category: string — one of [onboarding, it, benefits, hr, facilities, security]
faq_entry_schema.question: string — the question text, max 120 characters
faq_entry_schema.answer: string — the answer text, max 500 characters, plain language
faq_entry_schema.keywords: array of strings — 3 to 8 search-indexing tags
faq_entry_schema.source_document: string — citation to the validating policy or document
faq_entry_schema.audience: string — target audience [all_employees, new_hires, managers, engineering, design, sales]
faq_entry_schema.see_also: array of strings — related FAQ entry IDs or documentation URLs

categories.it: Technical questions about tools, access, and troubleshooting
categories.hr: Policies, time off, payroll, and employee relations
categories.facilities: Office access, rooms, parking, and equipment
